historical_record.description: The 5,468.75-square-foot corner parcel (62.5 feet on Larkin, 87.5 feet on North Point) held a non-conforming automobile service station, due to expire March 10, 1992, with a building covering almost half the site; the rest had been used as a parking lot without authorization, drawing a cease and desist order on September 28, 1973.

The City Planning Commission unanimously authorized, with conditions, a parking lot for 16 cars run with the existing non-conforming service station, requiring removal of the Larkin Street curb cuts, a barrier along the Larkin property line, and landscaping.
The site, formerly a service station, was in use as a parking lot.
A vacant lot stood at the property.
